canonical.title: A Kobarid weekend built around Hiša Franko

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Hiša Franko
siblings.summary: Only two beds-on-foot from Hiša Franko: the restaurant's own farmhouse rooms (dining guests only) and Apartment Žonir across the lane. Everything else is a taxi.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Hiša Franko
siblings.summary: Eight character stays — from the 1861 guesthouse attached to Hiša Franko to a 1000 m chalet quartet with a MICHELIN Key — all reachable by a Soča Valley taxi after dinner.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Hiša Franko
siblings.summary: Half-day and full-day picks around Kobarid — gorges, WWI sites, rafting, alpine drives and artisan food stops — timed to land you back for the 20:00 Hiša Franko seating.
